  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds: the issuing and IP countries differ, and CVV failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are absent, and no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) applies, but the completed id_check failed, so §5.3(b) now requires decline without Linkage. The established card and new non-home destination allow a benign gift explanation, but do not override the failure. The order is unshipped; decline prevents fulfilment, refunds the checkout payment and blocks the account. No further check would change the permitted disposition."
